function.name: query_database

args.sql:
SELECT AVG(step_count)::numeric(10,2) AS avg_steps
FROM (
  SELECT r.id, COUNT(s.id) AS step_count
  FROM runs r
  JOIN steps s ON s.run_id = r.id
  WHERE r.status = 'completed'
    AND r.created_at < '2026-10-28'
  GROUP BY r.id
) sub;
